method: Dice: common top face X; order side faces around it
steps: X on top in both views, so O is opposite X
Around X: T then S, and M then R in the same rotational direction
Cycle T, S, M, R gives T opposite M and S opposite R

method: Cube net folding (roll the net and compare face normals)
steps: Column Bat, Net, Stick, Goal: Bat opposite Stick, Net opposite Goal
Ball is attached left of Net, Field right of Goal, so they fold to opposite sides
Top: 3 small semicircles on the base line
2 medium semicircles each spanning two small ones
1 semicircle in the basket at the bottom
check_code:
top_small=3; top_double=2; top_full=1; basket=1
n=top_small+top_double+top_full+basket
assert n==7
for v in (6,5,8): assert n!=v
